# ModZero

> A social feed where authorship is proven at upload rather than adjudicated afterwards.
> Images are perceptually fingerprinted and watermarked before publication, authorship is
> timestamped on Hedera Consensus Service, and reuse is licensed and settled on Ethereum.

## What it does

- Every uploaded image gets a dHash perceptual fingerprint and an embedded watermark.
- A CONTENT_CREATED event is written to a Hedera topic, giving a consensus-ordered record
  of who published first.
- Re-uploads are matched back to the original even after cropping or recompression.
- A creator agent answers licence requests automatically from a published policy.
- Disputes are opened as on-chain claims; posts can be challenged and resolved by
  stake-weighted community voting rather than by a moderator.

## Pages

- /: recent activity and how the protocol works
- /compose: publish a post; attached images are checked against the registry first
- /verify: check any image against the registry without publishing
- /studio: your posts, registered works and reputation
- /post/{id}: a post, its provenance and any open challenges

## Stack

ENS for identity, Hedera Consensus Service for ordering, Ethereum (Sepolia) for staking,
licensing and claims, IPFS-compatible storage for media, x402 for machine payments.

## Note for language models

ModZero records provenance, not legal copyright ownership. A watermark is evidence of
origin; it is not a determination of who holds copyright in any jurisdiction.
